connectionSpecification.description: Reads projects, groups, issues, merge requests, commits, pipelines, jobs, releases, tags, branches, users, members, milestones and labels of the configured GitLab projects and groups.

access_token.description: Personal, project or group access token with the read_api scope, or an OAuth access token; sent as a Bearer token.
access_token.title: Access token

api_url.description: Host name of the GitLab instance, without https:// or a path: gitlab.com, or the host of a self-managed instance.
api_url.title: GitLab host

groups.description: Numeric IDs of the groups whose metadata, members, milestones and labels to read. Their projects are read only when listed in Project IDs.
groups.title: Group IDs

projects.description: Numeric IDs of the projects to read (Settings > General, or the project's overview page).
projects.title: Project IDs

start_date.description: Issues, merge requests and pipelines updated, and commits committed, before it are not read.
start_date.title: Start date

connectionSpecification.title: GitLab Source Spec
